slide_title: Minimization of Loss function to obtain BEST model parameters

labels: X is a matrix, W is a vector,
Get Best W that minimizes the loss
equations: Loss = 1/2 (Y - Ŷ)^T (Y - Ŷ) = 1/2 (Y - X W)^T (Y - X W)
Loss = 1/2 [ Y^T Y + (X W)^T (X W) - Y^T (X W) - (X W)^T Y ]
Loss = 1/2 [ Y^T Y + (X W)^T (X W) - 2 (X W)^T Y ]
